blurb: Run The Flex offers Hip Hop and Street Dance classes for all levels, including drop-in classes and structured programs. They provide a safe and inclusive space for individuals aged 14 and up to grow and connect through dance. The studio also offers kids and teens classes, private lessons, and corporate team building dance classes.
